An [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] '''clone commando''' attached to the [[Advanced Science Division]] served on [[Transport 904]]<ref name="Metamorphosis" /> during or after [[18 BBY]]. The [[transport]] carried a [[Cloning|cloned]] [[Zillo Beast]]—[[Specimen A]]—that ultimately broke out of captivity and [[Death|killed]] the vessel's crew, including the [[clone commando]].

==Biography==
During or after [[18 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> more than a [[Standard year|year]] after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], the [[clone commando]] was stationed aboard a [[Starship|vessel]] belonging to the Imperial [[Advanced Science Division]], designated as [[Transport 904]]. The vessel was transporting [[Specimen A]], a [[Cloning|cloned]] [[Zillo Beast]], to the [[Tantiss Base|Imperial facility]] on the [[planet]] [[Wayland]] when the cloned animal broke free from its containment and attacked the [[transport]]'s crew. After consuming nearly all of the ship's crewmembers and damaging it to the point of ripping it out of [[hyperspace]], the Zillo Beast set its sights on the clone [[commando]], who had managed to survive the initial slaughter.<ref name="Metamorphosis" /> 

Wielding an [[electrostaff]], the clone commando sprinted down the transport's corridors as the Zillo Beast chased after him. After turning a sharp corner and tripping over a loose cannister, the commando readied his electrostaff and prepared to stand his ground against the beast. After anxiously surveying his surroundings for a moment, the commando looked above himself only to immediately be snatched by the Zillo Beast clone and lifted into the ceiling shafts screaming in terror, where he was swiftly killed and consumed. The transport would eventually crash-land on the planet [[Silla]], where it encountered [[Clone Force 99]] before being [[Silla cloned Zillo Beast incident|recaptured]] by the Empire.<ref name="Metamorphosis" /> 

==Personality and traits==
As a clone of the male [[bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett]], the clone commando bore his [[Clone template|genetic template's]] basic physical characteristics.<ref name="Metamorphosis" /> 

The commando was fearful of the cloned Zillo Beast that had broken out of containment on Transport 904, but mustered the courage to stand his ground against the beast moments before his [[death]].<ref name="Metamorphosis" /> 

==Equipment==
The commando was equipped with [[Katarn-class commando armor|''Katarn''-class Commando Armor]] and briefly wielded an electrostaff.<ref name="Metamorphosis" />
